in_sanskrit.name: Avi
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Breath, Life
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Avi एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। In Sanskrit, ‘Avi’ is derived from the root ‘av’ meaning ‘breath’ or ‘life’. This name is associated with the Hindu god Vishnu, who is believed to sustain the universe with his breath.
